svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step two levels of metal lines lie buried in a flat pale oxide. After it a violet resist covers the oxide except for one window over the left-hand line of the upper level.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step two levels of metal lines lie buried in a flat pale oxide. After it a violet resist covers the oxide except for one window over the left-hand line of the upper level.
svg.text: Before: the cap oxide over metal 2 (step 128)
Resist is coated, exposed through the VIM2
reticle and developed, opening the via windows.
After: resist with a via-2 window
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
